context: a desktop app for managing recipes
_engines: rows in src/engines.json: "ollama" = local, the default 26B-A4B QAT MoE (~15 GB, most accurate and fastest measured, already set think:false for you) · "ollama-gemma3" = local, gemma3:12b (8.1 GB, equally accurate, 2.3x slower) · "gemini-free" = online smoke test only, 20 requests/day · "openai" = online, paid · "local-openai-compatible" = your own llama-server / LM Studio / vLLM. Switching engine is safer than overriding model: each row already carries the right settings for the model it names.

_optional.model: override the engine profile's model — required for a local server, whose model id is whatever YOU serve. Must be a pullable tag, e.g. hf.co/tencent/Hy-MT2-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M, not a shorthand.
_optional.url: override the engine profile's base URL
_optional.think: ollama only: false | true | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high'. Omitted = the model's own default. Set it to match the model you named: a thinking model returns EMPTY content unless it is false, and a non-thinking model does not care. Off on a thinking model is much faster and measurably worse on placeholders, so do not set it globally out of habit.
_optional.profile: any other engine-profile field, overridden per project — batchSize, rateLimitMs, timeoutMs, maxOutputTokens, headers, extraBody
